data.outcome_summary: This document is an IEA ICCS 2016 European regional report focused on young people’s perceptions of Europe within a broader civic and citizenship education framework. The excerpt states that ICCS 2016 provides data on students’ civic knowledge, attitudes, and engagement, and that the European option included regional questionnaire components covering European identity, recent European political/social events (e.g., immigration and freedom of movement), and European economic conditions and foreign policy. The report is designed to support comparisons across countries and over time (ICCS 2009 vs. ICCS 2016) and to examine variation within and between countries.
